page.layout: One page of text: a table of consular years and regnal dates, with no paragraphs. Each row has numeric columns and a name column, with a brace in the right margin marking each consular pair as "coss.". Running head at top, page number 52 at top left.

main_text.l: Pontius Pilatus Valerii Grati loco Procurator Ju-dææ. Ann. I.
28 | 31 | 73 | 781 | M. Junio Silano, P. Silio Nerva.coss.[?]
29 | 32 | 74 | 782 | C. Rubellio Gemino, C. Fufio Gemino.coss.
31 | 34 | 76 | 784 | Cl. Tiber. Nerone V.[?], Ælio Sejano.coss.[?]

page.notes: The right-margin "coss." marks are faint and partly covered by the brace; their exact spelling is uncertain on rows 780, 781, 783 and 784. The "V." after Nerone (784) is partly obscured. The regnal line "Ann. I." may be printed as "1."; I have given it as I. The reading of "Ju-dææ" assumes the hyphen is printed at the line end.
